text: A statistical analysis shows both accuracy and similarity have significant positive effects on judge scores, with the accuracy coefficient growing for more capable judges and the similarity effect greater for small judges (<32B); partial correlation controlling for accuracy still finds a significant similarity effect even for the best judges, and the authors conclude judgment scores are confounded by affinity bias.
title: Affinity bias persists after controlling for accuracy; stronger for judges under 32B
